Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>

CommitDate: Tue Dec 17 12:27:53 2024 -0500

    Bug 1937747 - Make sure the tabs API is fully loaded when the spaces API is used. r=mkmelin
    
    
    The `tabs.onCreated.addListener()` function is a synchronous child
    implementation, which returns as soon as the listener has been
    registered in the current child process, not waiting for the parent
    implementation of the tabs API to actually register a listener for the
    native `TabOpen` event. If the tab is opened through the spaces API, the
    parent implementation of the tabs API may not even be fully initialized
    and the pending event listener for the `TabOpen` event may not get
    registered in time.
    
    This was observed in tests recently added to
    `browser_ext_clickHandler.js` in D232068.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D232186

index dd92f2b2806..d6f7360e43d 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-spaces.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/parent/ext-spaces.js
@@ -103,6 +103,16 @@ this.spaces = class extends ExtensionAPI {
     const { tabManager } = extension;
     const self = this;
 
+    // Enforce full startup of the parent implementation of the tabs API. This is
+    // needed, because `tabs.onCreated.addListener()` is a synchronous child
+    // implementation, which returns as soon as the listener has been registered
+    // in the current child process, not waiting for the parent implementation of
+    // the tabs API to actually register a listener for the native TabOpen event.
+    // If the tab is opened through the spaces API, the parent implementation of
+    // the tabs API may not even be fully initialized and the pending event
+    // listener for the TabOpen event may not get registered in time.
+    extensions.loadModule("tabs");
+
     return {
       spaces: {
         async create(name, tabProperties, buttonProperties) {
